items.title: Ani Choying Dolma takes office as vice-chair of Lumbini Development Trust
items.summary: The Buddhist nun and renowned singer assumed her duties a month after her appointment, pledging to promote Lumbini as a destination for spiritual tourism.

items.title: Students can now obtain foreign degree equivalence online
items.summary: University Grants Commission also plans to revise PhD standards, resume research journal rankings, and grant autonomy to Prithvi Narayan Campus as part of wider higher education reforms.

items.title: Mishara’s record-breaking 120 gives Chitwan 204 against Kathmandu
items.summary: The Sri Lankan batter struck an unbeaten century and shared a 154-run stand with captain Ravi Bopara as Chitwan Rhinos set Kathmandu Gorkhas a target of 205 in the NPL Eliminator.

items.title: Madhesh government formation remains uncertain as deadline approaches
items.summary: Four parties are yet to agree on a coalition after the Congress-led government collapsed, with key leaders divided over whether to take power or wait until after the elections.

items.title: Chitwan and Kathmandu look to go beyond the Eliminator in NPL
items.summary: Kathmandu finished third and Chitwan fourth in the league stage, setting up a knockout clash for a place in the second qualifier of the Nepal Premier League.

items.title: Supreme Court sets November 23 hearing on Dan Bahadur Karki’s removal as police chief
items.summary: The court has sought a government explanation and given priority to the case, but declined to issue an interim order reinstating the former inspector general, allowing his successor to continue in office.

items.title: Luxembourg prince visits development projects in Kavre
items.summary: During a private visit to Bethanchok, Prince Louis pledged continued support for education and environmental conservation and met local representatives to discuss post-disaster recovery.

items.title: Ex-minister Sumana Shrestha announces bid for Kathmandu mayor
items.summary: The former RSP joint general secretary has yet to say whether she will contest as an independent or represent another political party.

items.title: Nepal urges China to reopen Tatopani border crossing
items.summary: Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal tells a visiting Chinese delegation that the crossing is crucial to connectivity, as the Rasuwagadhi route remains shut following the August floods.

items.title: The Clever Glamorization of Hard Lives
items.summary: Poverty isn't a personality, and resilience isn't a policy.
